text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ""SERR"... Neo Universe's "SERR"..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Negative. Our 'SERR'...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: The "orbit" is... beginning to return.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: From here, or perhaps—

After finishing the race, Neo Universe 
looked very happy...

As if reclaiming a long-lost cherished 
treasure.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, "KERB" truly is "inseparable", 
isn't it...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe was able to "revive." Very…… 
"DIGG"……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: That's why... as "one."

It was a strange sensation. I could feel 
all of Neo Universe's ineffable joy 
flowing right into me.

It was as if our hearts were directly 
connected. And then—

This wish... this prayer... this 
symbiosis... I feel like it wasn't born 
just here and now.

A wish that echoes strongly in every 
universe—

"If only we could keep running 
together—just like this."

That night—a very, very long discussion 
was held regarding the next race.

A month and a half until the fateful 
"GATE," the Tenno Sho (Spring). It was 
time to make a decision.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe places it 'on the 
table'. The 'Tenno Sho (Spring)'—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Detour—is that an option?

A detour... In other words, choosing not 
to run. Is avoiding the race itself to 
flee from a vanishing future a viable 
choice, or not?
However...
choice_data_list:
Not sure if that'll really help us avoid 
it, though.

We can't be sure if that'll help us avoid 
it, though.

text_block_list.text:
It seemed Neo Universe felt the same way. 
There was no telling if such superficial 
methods could truly avert her vanishing.

As long as I am an Umamusume, I can't keep 
running away from races forever. Even if I 
could protect myself—

You can't save Zenno Rob Roy. She'll just 
be swallowed up by the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe is no longer— Like 
the alternate universe."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: With that momentum just now, maybe...
choice_data_list: It'll be a gamble, though, huh.

text_block_list.text:
There are no guarantees. None for success, 
none for failure. However—

We can still make efforts to increase our 
chances of success. There's still a month 
and a half until the Tenno Sho (Spring), 
after all.
choice_data_list: Universe, I have something to tell you
Universe, I have something to tell you

text_block_list.text:
I confided that story to them—about the 
possibility that it hadn't vanished, but 
was simply invisible.
Neo Universe looked surprised. And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That possibility is "not entirely out of 
the question"... Even if that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――The root of the "noise." I want to 
verify the "crack in the James Webb."

What they said made total sense. I had to 
unravel the mystery in the time that 
remained. And beyond that—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: I'm... coming...

"I've done everything I could. I truly 
felt that I had put in every ounce of 
effort required."

Once all preparations are made, the only 
thing left is to race. It was the same in 
racing as it was in life.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Neo Universe was completely content until 
today. That is why..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: —I want to go.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
I want to go... and break through. 
Together, the two of us, past the "GATE" 
of the Tenno Sho (Spring).
